name: How much does an obstetric malpractice attorney cost?
description: Most obstetric malpractice attorneys work on a contingency fee basis, meaning they only get paid if you win your case, as a percentage of your recovery.

mainEntity.name: How much does an obstetric malpractice attorney cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most obstetric malpractice attorneys work on a contingency fee basis. This means you generally do not pay upfront legal fees. Instead, the attorney's fees are a percentage of the compensation you receive if your case is successful, either through a settlement or a court award. If your case is not successful, you typically do not owe attorney's fees. This arrangement allows individuals to pursue justice without needing to pay large retainers upfront. You will discuss the specific percentage during your initial consultation.
